# Dunite Labs

> Dunite Labs (also written "dunitelabs" or "Dunite") is an independent app studio based in India,
> founded in 2024. It builds offline-first Android apps, websites and tools. Everything works without
> a network connection; cloud features are optional. No ads, no trackers.

- Website: https://dunitelabs.com
- About: https://dunitelabs.com/about/
- Contact: dunitelabs.support@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/dunitelabs

## Apps

- [Guava Music](https://dunitelabs.com/app/guava-music/): Offline-first Android music player and personal
  cloud locker. Plays the music already on the device — folder browser, playlists, equaliser, sleep timer,
  lyrics, optional sync through the user's own Google Drive. No ads, no tracking.
- [Speedmaths Pro](https://dunitelabs.com/app/speedmaths-pro/): Android mental-maths trainer with daily
  ranked quizzes, custom operation drills, a mastery game, heatmaps and badges.
- [Govt Jobs Notice](https://dunitelabs.com/app/govtjobsnotice/): Clean website aggregating Indian
  government job notices — verified listings, working filters, admit-card and result tracking, no popups.
  Live at https://www.govtjobsnotice.com/
